summary: End-to-end review of the rewritten PER-PHASE AI Project Brief flow. Backend: full regression 264/264 PASS (~199s) excluding phase11/12/13/15/master per main agent instructions + 3/3 PASS on test_brief_per_phase.py (state machine, milestone sync, auth guards; 41s due to ~25s LLM call for Emergent dev task seeding) + 3/3 PASS on test_project_brief_e2e.py. Frontend: client portal /portal?tab=brief renders progress bar, per-phase card with rendered HTML summary (<strong>/<h2>/<ul> all pass through bleach sanitiser), comment textarea + 24h SLA hint, legal checkbox with EXACT required wording, Approve Phase button correctly disabled until checkbox ticked, final 'Approve full Project Brief' button correctly disabled until all 3 phases approved. Comment submission successfully flips card to 'Our team is reviewing…' state. Admin dialog renders TipTap WYSIWYG editor with rt-bold/rt-italic toolbar, 3 phase tabs with live status pills ('CLIENT COMMENTED' shown after client comment), Save/Send/Prompt-copy/History-toggle/Reply-chip all visible with correct testids. Latest client comment surfaces prominently in admin dialog with 'Show history (1)' revision history toggle.

issues: Console warning: '[tiptap warn]: Duplicate extension names found: [link]. This can lead to issues.' — both StarterKit and an explicitly added Link extension register 'link'. Should disable link inside StarterKit or remove the duplicate to silence warning. Non-blocking, editor functions correctly.

action_items: Minor: Silence the TipTap 'Duplicate extension names found: [link]' console warning in RichTextEditor.jsx (disable StarterKit link or drop the explicit Link import).

Optional regression coverage: add a pytest case asserting the per-phase Emailit fire-and-forget does NOT 500 the send-for-review endpoint when SMTP is unreachable (currently only smoke-tested via try/except).
critical_code_review_comments: Per-phase state machine works correctly across all 18 transitions: draft → sent_for_review → in_revision (comment) → draft (PATCH) → sent_for_review → approved. Verified via backend test + UI smoke.
Approve guard returns 400 when no_comments_confirmed=false, 200 when true, 409 when phase not in sent_for_review — all 3 paths verified by test_full_state_machine.
Phase lock-on-approval works: PATCH on approved phase returns 409 (test verified).
HTML sanitisation via bleach strips <script> tags while preserving allowed tags (p/strong/em/h2/h3/ul/li/a/blockquote/code/pre) — verified in test_full_state_machine assertion 3.
Final approval gate refuses with 409 unless all 3 phases approved — verified assertion 14.

On full approval: brief flips to status=approved, 5 standard build milestones seeded (Discovery / Design / Build / QA / Launch + 3 Brief Review milestones), Project Mode workspace created with LLM-generated dev tasks (poll-verified within 60s), PDF brief snapshot uploaded to project_files (cleanup fixture deletes it) — all assertions 16-18 pass.

Live milestone sync verified for all 3 status text variants: 'Waiting for your review.' (sent_for_review), 'Our team is reviewing your comments…' (in_revision), 'Approved — locked in.' / status=complete (approved) — assertion in test_review_milestone_status_sync.
Auth guards: unauth POST to send-for-review and comment both return 401/403 — verified.

Client portal /portal?tab=brief renders correctly with all required data-testids; legal checkbox text matches the exact required wording verbatim ('I have reviewed Phase 1\'s summary, I confirm that this is correct and I am leaving no comments. By checking this box, I understand that any requests made outside the scope of this summary may incur new fees.').

Admin ProjectBriefDialog renders all required testids: brief-dialog, brief-tab-phase1/2/3, brief-summary-phase1 (editable when not locked), rt-bold, rt-italic, brief-save-phase1, brief-send-phase1, brief-prompt-copy-phase1, brief-history-toggle-phase1.
Status pill on admin Phase 1 tab correctly flips to 'CLIENT COMMENTED' after client posts a comment — confirmed visually.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical testids resolve & state transitions work; 1 non-blocking TipTap console warning)
